integrity: Mathematical proof and independently executable finite checker supplied; finite results are not used as the infinite-field proof. Independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only rank-three first-order sentences in the pure graph language are classified; no higher-rank or limit-theory assertion. The finite tester covers GF(2) and GF(3) examples, while the written proof ranges over all prime powers. Historical priority remains subject to potential general distance-regular graph to logical-type reductions and unindexed sources.
title: Four quantifier-rank-three theories of finite Grassmann adjacency graphs
